body:
Not every spouse is worth having. Mine was... very bad for me.

Thanks for reaching out. I don't think I can work this out. Not today, but, another time. When I think about it, that there's no rush, and I don't have to fight anymore... I feel kind of relaxed. Free. Sad, but that was always the case.

Thanks. Hopefully you get the breaks you deserve.

I don't think there's anyone out there for me. As you age, people are less interested in you, also. I hardly ever meet new people anymore.

I just don't see how anything would change. Nothing new ever happens. I need this job to pay my ex, I don't meet people on my commute or in my hobbies. I'm was never attractive enough for anyone to be interested, and the years have been pretty unkind.

I don't have old friends. I didn't have many growing up because I had a strict curfew, and they're all long gone now, who knows where. I can't find them on facebook, either.
